Hi Avery — attaching the Service Addendum capturing the temporary SLO carve-out and pilot controls we discussed. High-level summary:

- Pilot window: 90 days starting on first production traffic (we'll target Dec 7 kickoff).
- Temporary SLOs for Edge Encoder v0.9: 95% availability and p95 latency <= 100ms limited to the agreed pilot routes/volume.
- Traffic cap: baseline 2 QPS with scheduled batch windows not exceeding 10 QPS for max 30 minutes; any sustained increase requires prior written approval.
- Monitoring & rollback: route-level dashboard, daily digest, and automatic fallback to the GA encoder within 2 minutes of sustained breach (defined in Section 3.2).
- Credits: preview carve-out is not credit-eligible; however Redwood will provide a one-time $5k onboarding credit if pilot traffic exceeds agreed caps in first 30 days.
- Termination: either party can terminate pilot with 24-hour notice; Redwood reserves the right to pause if platform-wide impact is observed.
